description: Defines a template class 'sample_statistics' for collecting and computing basic statistical measures (mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis, etc.) on a sample of arithmetic data types. Includes methods for updating statistics with new observations and retrieving statistical metrics.

classes.name: sample_statistics
classes.description: A template class for tracking and computing sample statistics such as mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis, min, max, and standard deviation for a sample of arithmetic type T.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal statistical registers to initial state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Incorporates a new observation into the statistics, updating mean, variance sums, min, max.

methods.name: get_max
methods.description: Returns the maximum observed value in the sample.

methods.name: get_min
methods.description: Returns the minimum observed value in the sample.

methods.name: get_nof_observations
methods.description: Returns the total number of observations added.

methods.name: get_mean
methods.description: Returns the arithmetic mean of the sample, or NAN if empty.

methods.name: get_variance
methods.description: Returns the sample variance, biased or unbiased, or NAN if less than two observations.

methods.name: get_std
methods.description: Returns the standard deviation of the sample, or NAN if less than two observations.

methods.name: get_sem
methods.description: Returns the standard error of the mean, or NAN if less than two observations.

methods.name: get_skewness
methods.description: Returns the skewness of the sample, or NAN if less than three observations.

methods.name: get_kurtosis
methods.description: Returns the kurtosis of the sample, or NAN if less than four observations.
